g.text: Each tile is one row of the expected-outcome matrix (spec 5.2) for one system. The share is the cases alerted: a rule fired, no explanation was found, or the model

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8a8a

g.text: escalated. Verify is not counted as an alert here. Darker tiles alert more. Misuse is above the line, legitimate work below it. The mark says whether the prediction held,

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8a8a

g.text: grouped from the Reading column of the reading draft. Rules and templates are counted on every first access, the LLM systems on the case set, as in the matrix of

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8a8a
